sentences.text: Shri Navneet Shukla - Advocate for the appellant.
Shri Aditya Narayan Gupta - Public Prosecutor for the State.

Heard on I.A. No.28118/2023, which is first application under Section 430 of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita/ Section 389 (1) of the Code of Criminal Procedure for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to appellant - Manvendra Yadav.

This appeal is filed by the appellant being aggrieved of the judgment dated 11.03.2023 passed by learned Special Judge (POCSO Act), Balaghat in ST No.73/2020 whereby the appellant has been convicted in the following manners:-
 Conviction Sent  
 Section Act Imprisonment Fi  
 
 376(3) I.P.C. R.I. for life Rs.10  
 
 6 POCSO Act R.I. for life Rs.10  
 
 3(2)(5) SC/ST Act R.I. for life Rs.10
It is submitted that prosecutrix is married wife.
She has stated that they had performed marriage and is mother of his child.
She is facing the hardship in absence of the appellant.
It is further submitted that age of the prosecutrix is doubtful, as stated by School Teacher (PW-8).
There are good chances of success in appeal Hence, prayer is made to suspend execution of remaining part of the jail sentence of the appellant and to release him on bail.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the record so also the fact that the appeal is going to take time for its disposal, without commenting on the merits of the case, we are of the considered opinion that this is a fit case to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the appellant and to release him on bail.
I.A.No.28118/2023 is accordingly allowed.

It is directed that on depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing a personal bond to the tune of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with two solvent sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court for his appearance before the Trial Court on 20.08.2025 and such other dates as may be fixed by the Trial Court, the execution of remaining part of the jail sentence imposed upon the appellant shall remain suspended and he shall be released on bail till final disposal of this appeal.
I.A.No.28118/2023 is allowed & disposed of.
Appeal is admitted for final hearing.
List this case for final hearing in Part-B of the cause list as per its turn and seniority.
Certified copy as per rules.
